scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @veridict/web" "npm run dev -w @veridict/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @veridict/contracts && npm run build -w @veridict/api -w @veridict/web -w @veridict/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @veridict/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.agent:smoke: npm run build -w @veridict/contracts && npm run build -w @veridict/agent && npm run smoke -w @veridict/agent
